TRANSACTION - FUNCTIONAL DESCRIPTION: Approves the creation of a pending approval pricing rule
EXECUTION FLOWS - DETAILED DESCRIPTION: 1. The transaction retrieves input parameter pricingRuleId and calls ABKOR005.executeApprovePricingRule with that identifier. 2. The library loads the pricing rule by ID, loads its active details and resolves each detail value; it raises ABKO10010004 when a detail has no configured resolution query, when the resolved detail value is null or blank, or when the detail lookup throws NoResultException. 3. The library validates that the pricing rule exists and raises ABKO10000405 when the queried rule is null, and it validates that the current status is PAA, PAU or PAD and raises ABKO10000411 when the status is different. 4. If validation passes, the library obtains an audit log ID, reads the request user code and chooses the approval branch: it approves the rule with status APR when the status is PAA or PAU without parent, first updates the parent rule to DBU and then approves the rule with status APR when the status is PAU with parent, or approves the rule with status APD when the status is PAD. 5. During the status update, the repository raises ABKO00000010 when the database update for the pricing rule status affects zero rows; any PricingRuleException raised in the flow is converted into an advice with its code and description, and the transaction sets severity EWR when the advice list is not empty. 6. If the library returns a non-null PricingRuleDTO, the transaction assigns it to output parameter pricingRuleResponse; if the library returns null, the output is not assigned.

Accessed Libraries.Description: Approves a pending approval pricing rule by loading the rule and its details, validating its current status, recording audit data and updating the rule status, including parent approval handling when applicable.

Input Parameters.Description: Identifies the pricing rule to approve and is used to load the rule, its details and the approval updates.

Output Parameters.Description: Approved pricing rule returned when the library completes without advice; the transaction does not assign this output if the library returns null.
